description: A ride's second-by-second data averaged down to resolution_s (default 30; at most 720 points, so long rides get a coarser resolution). fields from: power, target, hr, cadence, right_pct, speed, distance, step. Default: power, hr, cadence. t_s is the start of each interval in recorded seconds.
name: get_ride_series
title: Ride data over time
